# Example Project Knowledge Base

> A minimal example vault for agent-kb. Start here, then read _summary.md.

This file is the top-level entry point for an agent reading this vault
just-in-time: read this, then `_summary.md`, then only the specific
article(s) you need — avoid loading the whole vault into context at once.

## Articles
- widget-api.md — the current widget API
- auth-flow.md — the auth pattern the widget API depends on
- legacy-endpoint.md — a deprecated endpoint (deliberately stale, for demo purposes)
- rate-limit-policy.md — a settled decision (`reverify_after: never`, for demo purposes)
